review_description: Solar Access Group were the installer for the company we purchased our system from.  Their work was excellent and highly professional.

We could not recommend enough Solar Access Group. We have a high quality system that is second to none in terms of meeting our needs, the quality of components, professional installation and brilliant service. We also have' real' value for money given the end product. A fantastic result for our family..

We chose Solar Access Group because of the proffessionalism, their great presentation, and frankly, they were the only company we got a quote from that we had any confidence in. The workmanship was fastidious and we were very happy overall.

We chose Solar Access Group after considering the extremely detailed and professional quotation package they put together for us. They designed a system tailored to our usage, and explained fully the entire process regarding STC's, equipment supplied and installation. They weren't the cheapest quote we had, but they use high quality components. I'm a firm believer in "you get what you pay for".System installation was quick, on time and very professional.I have no hesitation in recommending Solar Access Group to anyone in Melbourne considering a solar power system.

After spending a lot of time looking into solar, Solar Access Group were the only company that we had any real confidence in. A lot of other companies only quoted over the phone without even viewing our property. The only other quote we had from someone who visited the house was clearly just a salesman, spewing out a spiel. Solar Access Group sent a designer who was also the installer and able to answer all of our queries. The attention to detail on the installation was meticulous as was the provided documentation.
We were very happy with the information, quality of materials, workmanship and prompt service and I am happy to recommend this supplier.
